verdict.rationale: Trello documents a feature to "View work from Jira in a Trello list", which brings one other project management tool's work into a Trello view. The Inbox capture from email and Slack is intake, not aggregation of PM tools. Nothing shows filtering to the engineer's assigned tasks or combining several PM tools in one view. Missing for 10: aggregation across multiple PM tools beyond Jira, a filtered view of assigned tasks, in-depth docs on the Jira view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: View work from Jira in a Trello list
